# FedEx Images

> FedEx Images serves as a global resource hub for shipping, tracking, and delivery solutions across multiple regional markets including Canada, the United States, and international destinations.

Images.fedex.com provides core shipping and logistics resources, regional homepages, and global navigation tools to help customers access FedEx services across different countries and regions. The site emphasizes international shipping capabilities, package tracking, and location-based service discovery.

## Key Topics

- FedEx Canada
- International shipping
- Package tracking
- Shipping tools
- Global locations
- FedEx Mobile app
- Delivery management
- Regional services
- Location selector
- Shipping rates
- Returns solutions
- Global site navigation

## Regional Hubs & Core Services

- [FedEx Canada Homepage](https://images.fedex.com/en-ca/home.html): FedEx Canada homepage with shipping, tracking, and delivery solutions
- [Global Location Selector](https://images.fedex.com/global/choose-location.html): Global location selector for FedEx regional sites and services across multiple countries and regions

## Optional

- [Page Not Found](https://images.fedex.com/international/wineship/us_canada_faq.html): Error page indicating unavailable content on fedex.com
